definitions.gloss: division of roles, division of labor
definitions.explanation: The allocation of different tasks or responsibilities among members of a group or organization.

examples.japanese: {役割分担|やくわりぶんたん}を{決|き}める。
examples.english: To decide the division of roles.

examples.japanese: {家事|かじ}の{役割分担|やくわりぶんたん}を{見直|みなお}す。
examples.english: To reconsider the division of household chores.

examples.japanese: チーム{内|ない}の{役割分担|やくわりぶんたん}が{明確|めいかく}だ。
examples.english: The division of roles within the team is clear.

examples.japanese: {効率|こうりつ}よく{作業|さぎょう}するために{役割分担|やくわりぶんたん}した。
examples.english: We divided up the roles to work efficiently.

notes:
{役割分担|やくわりぶんたん} means dividing responsibilities among people.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {役割|やくわり}: role, part
- {分担|ぶんたん}: sharing, division

USAGE:
- {家事|かじ}の{役割分担|やくわりぶんたん}: division of household chores
- {仕事|しごと}の{役割分担|やくわりぶんたん}: division of work duties
- {国際|こくさい}{的|てき}な{役割分担|やくわりぶんたん}: international division of labor

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {役割分担|やくわりぶんたん}を{決|き}める: to decide the division of roles
- {役割分担|やくわりぶんたん}を{見直|みなお}す: to review the division of roles
- {役割分担|やくわりぶんたん}が{不明確|ふめいかく}: unclear division of roles

RELATED WORDS:
- {分業|ぶんぎょう}: division of labor
- {担当|たんとう}: being in charge
- {責任分担|せきにんぶんたん}: division of responsibilities
